Meri jaan,

Aj tum or badi ho gayi — ek aur phase agya hehehe... Happy birthday to my dearest wife, best friend, my best buddy, my best life partner. That place is only for you. I love you meri cutie pie, my babe, baby, wife, bagum, patani hehee.

We had so much in life, still struggling, but I never lost trust and my belief. I hope you didn't either, because we are still together till now — and we will be in the future as well. I want you to ask something from me, a birthday gift, anything you want from me, okay?

And I want you to promise me — agar apko mujhse koi bhi problem, koi bhi sikayat ho, to please bol diya karna. Apki chupi mujhe bohot tod deti hai. I want you to trust me, ik you do, but I want you to believe in me in every period of time, even if it is a bad moment. Hum dono ek dusre ka saath khade ho. We got each other's back because it's not you or me — it is we, it is hum.

Ap mujh pe apna pura hak dikhaya karo, main apka hi hun. And I love you. I will always. I care so much about you meri jaan. I never told you how much I think, care and love you. Ap jitna bhi time mujhse dur thi, I was alive because ik you love me. I trusted the fact that we will reunite again — and we did. Your memories have always meant the world to me.

Vo sab choro — happiest birthday meri jaan, my love. A lil letter and this little thing for you, hope you like it. Ap saamne nahi ho, nahi to bohot sara hugs, kisses, cuddle deta apko, and gifts bhi. Muahhh meri jaan. And sorry if I ever hurted you by mistake hehe. ♡

Always yours,
Shaureya ♡
